channel.title: UEFA Champions League Football
channel.desc: Highlights of the UEFA Champions League play-offs including Celtic against Austrian champions LASK, one of seven first-leg ties as the final places in this season's competition are decided. The winner in each tie over two legs will compete in the league phase from September until January, with eight guaranteed matches and huge financial reward. Celtic were knocked out in the play-offs last season on penalties by Kazakh club Kairat Almaty.
